messages.content: What concrete class is specified for the basement walls?

The basement retaining walls are specified as **C32/40** with exposure classes **XC4, XD3 and XA2**, a maximum water-cement ratio of 0.45 and a minimum binder content of 340 kg/m³. The mix must include a crystalline waterproofing admixture (AquaLock CX at 1.0% of binder). Greystone's approved mix is **GRM-3240-XD3-WP**.

citations.quote: Basement retaining walls (350 mm thick): strength class C32/40, exposure classes XC4, XD3 and XA2, maximum water-cement ratio 0.45, minimum binder content 340 kg/m³.
The raft and basement wall concrete shall contain a crystalline waterproofing admixture, AquaLock CX or equal approved, dosed at 1.0% by mass of total binder
Mix reference: GRM-3240-XD3-WP. Project: Aldermoor Court (Halvern Build Ltd). Element: basement retaining walls.

messages.content: And what's the max water-cement ratio? Greystone keep asking about it.

**0.45 maximum**, calculated on the total cementitious content (the slag in CEM III/A counts in full). RFI-017 confirmed the limit is governed by the XD3/XA2 exposure classes and is **not relaxed** by the crystalline admixture. Greystone's approved mix runs at **0.42**.

citations.quote: Water-cement ratio means the ratio of free water to total cementitious content (cement plus any ground granulated blast-furnace slag or fly ash counted in accordance with EN 206).
The maximum water-cement ratio of 0.45 is governed by the XD3 and XA2 exposure classes and is not relaxed by the use of the crystalline admixture
Greystone Ready-Mix has submitted mix GRM-3240-XD3-WP (data sheet ALD-DS-GRM-3240) with a free water-cement ratio of 0.42 and 360 kg/m³ of CEM III/A

messages.content: How is the basement waterproofed overall?

The basement uses **combined protection**:

- **Type B** structurally integral concrete (raft and walls with crystalline admixture) throughout; the car park must reach **Grade 2**
- **Type C** drained cavity in the plant room and cycle store, which must reach **Grade 3**
- A hydrophilic waterbar plus re-injectable hose at every kicker and construction joint

The injection hose was used to seal the W2/W3 joint leak found in July 2026.

citations.quote: Type B (structurally integral) protection is provided by the raft and retaining walls with the crystalline admixture.
In addition, Type C (drained cavity) protection is required to the plant room and cycle store, which shall achieve a Grade 3 environment.
All kicker joints and vertical construction joints in the raft and basement walls shall incorporate a hydrophilic waterbar strip together with a re-injectable injection hose.
Remedial injection of the W2/W3 joint and sleeve S-14 was carried out by Sealtech Injection Services on Wednesday 15 July 2026.

messages.content: What changed with the glazing on the east elevation?

Under **ALD-CO-007** (approved 1 October 2026), the 18 windows and 6 balcony doors facing Aldermoor Road on **Levels 1–3** get **acoustic laminated double glazing** achieving **Rw+Ctr 36 dB**. This followed the updated acoustic assessment after the new bus route was confirmed. The change adds £9,850 and has no programme impact, as Velto includes the units in the first production batch.

citations.quote: The windows and balcony doors on the east elevation facing Aldermoor Road, at Levels 1, 2 and 3, are upgraded to acoustic laminated double glazing.
Required performance: sound reduction Rw+Ctr 36 dB in the closed position, tested to EN ISO 10140.
LO reported that the updated acoustic assessment, issued after the bus route on Aldermoor Road was confirmed, requires higher sound insulation to the bedrooms and living rooms facing Aldermoor Road.
Velto Windows will include them in the first production batch (Levels 1 and 2) so there is no impact on the window installation start or the completion date.

messages.content: Does the acoustic glazing still meet the window U-value?

The spec requires a whole-window **Uw ≤ 1.2 W/m²K**, with double glazing at **Ug ≤ 1.0 W/m²K** (warm edge, argon). The Velto AX70 system achieves **Uw 1.1 W/m²K** for the reference window. The acoustic units on the east elevation (CO-007) must still achieve Uw 1.2 W/m²K or better.

citations.quote: The whole-window thermal transmittance shall not exceed Uw 1.2 W/m²K, calculated to EN ISO 10077 for the standard window size.
Whole window Uw with double glazing Ug 1.0 W/m²K and warm edge spacer: 1.1 W/m²K for the reference window 1,230 x 1,480 mm.
The whole-window thermal transmittance remains Uw 1.2 W/m²K or better
